model_outputs.test_source:
import pytest
from datetime import date
from calendar_app import add_months

def test_add_months_preserves_day_and_clamps():
    # positive month offset
    assert add_months(date(2026, 1, 31), 1) == date(2026, 2, 28)
    # negative month offset
    assert add_months(date(2026, 3, 31), -1) == date(2026, 2, 28)
    # zero offset
    assert add_months(date(2026, 5, 15), 0) == date(2026, 5, 15)
    # month length variation
    assert add_months(date(2026, 2, 28), 1) == date(2026, 3, 28)
    assert add_months(date(2026, 1, 30), 1) == date(2026, 2, 28)  # Jan30 +1 month -> Feb28 (clamp)
    # leap year
    assert add_months(date(2024, 1, 31), 1) == date(2024, 2, 29)
    # crossing year boundary
    assert add_months(date(2026, 11, 30), 2) == date(2027, 1, 30)
    # negative crossing year boundary
    assert add_months(date(2027, 1, 30), -2) == date(2026, 11, 30)

edits.old:
def add_months(day, months):
    return day + timedelta(days=30 * months)
edits.new:
def add_months(day, months):
    return day + relativedelta(months=months)
